title: EfficientIP: DHCP Service Failed or Stopped
description: DHCP daemon stopped, failed, exited, or is not running.
query: message:dhcpd AND (message:stopped OR message:failed OR message:"not running" OR message:terminated OR message:exited)

title: EfficientIP: DHCP Failover Peer Issue
query: message:dhcpd AND (message:failover OR message:peer OR message:partner OR message:"communications-interrupted" OR message:"not responding")

title: EfficientIP: DHCP Config Load Failure
description: DHCP configuration syntax, parsing, or load failure.
query: message:dhcpd AND (message:"syntax error" OR message:"bad config" OR message:"configuration file" OR message:"failed to load" OR message:"parse error")

title: EfficientIP: DNS Service Failed or Stopped
description: DNS service stopped, failed, exited, or is not running.
query: (message:named OR message:bind) AND (message:stopped OR message:failed OR message:"not running" OR message:exited OR message:terminated)

title: EfficientIP: DNS Zone Load Failure
description: DNS zone failed to load or has errors.
query: (message:named OR message:bind) AND message:zone AND (message:failed OR message:"not loaded" OR message:"loading failed" OR message:"has errors" OR message:"not loaded due to errors")

title: EfficientIP: DNS Zone Transfer Failure
description: DNS AXFR/IXFR/zone transfer or refresh failure.
query: (message:named OR message:bind) AND (message:"zone transfer" OR message:AXFR OR message:IXFR OR message:"transfer failed" OR message:"refresh failed" OR message:"transfer of")

title: EfficientIP: Deployment or Publish Failure
description: EfficientIP/SOLIDserver deployment, push, publication, or publish failure.
query: (message:SOLIDserver OR message:efficientip OR message:eip) AND (message:deploy OR message:deployment OR message:push OR message:publish OR message:publication) AND (message:failed OR message:error)

title: EfficientIP: Core or Database Service Failure
description: EfficientIP/SOLIDserver core service or database failure.
query: (message:SOLIDserver OR message:efficientip OR message:eip OR message:database OR message:postgres OR message:mysql) AND (message:failed OR message:stopped OR message:"not running" OR message:"connection refused" OR message:"database unavailable")

title: EfficientIP: Backup Failure
query: (message:backup OR message:archive) AND (message:failed OR message:error OR message:failure)
